cba_by_season.2011: 2011 CBA — 10yr, rookie wage scale, 47-48.5% revenue split
cba_by_season.2020: 2020 CBA — 17-game season, 48% player share grows to 48.5%, playoff expansion
cba_by_season.2024: 2020 CBA — $110B TV deal starts 2023, cap spike 2024

notes.hard_cap_vs_soft: NFL is hard cap (no luxury tax/aprons unlike NBA 2023 CBA). Single threshold — dead cap hits matter more than cap_pct.
notes.franchise_tag: Tag value = top5 avg at position — restricts mobility, analog to NBA max but team-initiated.
notes.cap_floor: 89% cash spend floor over 4yr period (2021-24 89%) — no per-season floor like NBA 90%.
notes.spike_year: 2024 +$30.6M (13.6%) from $110B TV — NFL equivalent of NBA 2016 +34% spike, but mandatory smoothing 2025+ via 2020 CBA growth formula.
notes.source: Spotrac, OverTheCap, ESPN, NFL Communications 2025 official $279.2M team cap
